bane.description: Your prayers cause the living to fall into a slumber and call the dead back into Morr’s realm. While this blessing is recharging, all living and dead targets in the engagement gain the Sluggish condition. This blessing has no effect on creatures that are neither living nor dead (i.e. daemons).

conservative.requirements: 4 favour, +1 favour per character in target engagement within medium range. Must perform the prepare manoeuvre

success.description: As above, and living targets with fatigue (or wounds if they do not track fatigue) in excess of their WP fall into a normal slumber. Undead targets with wounds in excess of their WP are destroyed.
